question: top 10 named buildings by open restaurant count
sql:
SELECT b.id, b.names."primary" AS building_name, COUNT(*) AS open_restaurants
FROM lisbon_buildings b
JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry)
WHERE b.names."primary" IS NOT NULL
  AND p.basic_category = 'restaurant'
  AND p.operating_status = 'open'
GROUP BY b.id, b.names."primary"
ORDER BY open_restaurants DESC, b.id
LIMIT 10;

question: avg pois per building by building subtype
sql:
WITH per_building AS (
  SELECT b.id, b.subtype, COUNT(*) AS poi_count
  FROM lisbon_buildings b
  JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry)
  GROUP BY b.id, b.subtype
)
SELECT subtype,
       COUNT(*) AS buildings_with_pois,
       AVG(poi_count) AS avg_pois_per_building,
       MAX(poi_count) AS busiest_building_pois
FROM per_building
GROUP BY subtype
ORDER BY avg_pois_per_building DESC, subtype;

question: poi counts for buildings taller than 20m
sql:
SELECT b.id, b.names."primary" AS building_name, b.height, b.num_floors, COUNT(*) AS pois
FROM lisbon_buildings b
JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry)
WHERE b.height > 20
GROUP BY b.id, b.names."primary", b.height, b.num_floors
ORDER BY pois DESC, b.height DESC, b.id;

question: total height of buildings containing a bakery
sql:
WITH bakery_buildings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.id, b.height
  FROM lisbon_buildings b
  JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry)
  WHERE p.taxonomy."primary" = 'bakery'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS buildings_with_bakery,
       SUM(height) AS total_height_m
FROM bakery_buildings;

question: pois within 200m of each education building centroid
sql:
SELECT b.id, b.names."primary" AS building_name, COUNT(*) AS pois_within_200m
FROM lisbon_buildings b
JOIN lisbon_places p
  ON ST_DWithin_Spheroid(ST_Centroid(b.geometry), p.geometry, 200)
WHERE b.subtype = 'education'
GROUP BY b.id, b.names."primary"
ORDER BY pois_within_200m DESC, b.id;

question: geojson footprints of buildings with historic site pois
sql:
SELECT b.id, b.names."primary" AS building_name, COUNT(*) AS historic_site_pois,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS footprint_geojson
FROM lisbon_buildings b
JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, p.geometry)
WHERE p.taxonomy."primary" = 'historic_site'
GROUP BY b.id, b.names."primary", b.geometry
ORDER BY historic_site_pois DESC, b.id
LIMIT 5;
